use crate::api::*;
use crate::distance::l2_distance;

const DIM: usize = 128;

pub struct VectorDB {
    // Flat storage for better cache locality
    // All vectors stored contiguously in a single buffer
    ids: RwLock<Vec<u64>>,
    vectors: RwLock<Vec<f32>>,
    count: RwLock<usize>,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        VectorDB {
            ids: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            vectors: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            count: RwLock::new(0),
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        let mut ids = self.ids.write().unwrap();
        let mut vectors = self.vectors.write().unwrap();
        let mut count = self.count.write().unwrap();
        
        ids.push(id);
        vectors.extend(vector);
        *count += 1;
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, new_vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut ids = self.ids.write().unwrap();
        let mut vectors = self.vectors.write().unwrap();
        let mut count = self.count.write().unwrap();
        
        let mut new_ids = Vec::with_capacity(new_vectors.len());
        let mut new_data = Vec::with_capacity(new_vectors.len() * DIM);
        
        for (id, vec) in new_vectors {
            new_ids.push(id);
            new_data.extend(vec);
        }
        
        let inserted = new_ids.len();
        ids.append(&mut new_ids);
        vectors.extend(new_data);
        *count += inserted;
        
        inserted
    }

    pub fn search(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        let ids = self.ids.read().unwrap();
        let vectors = self.vectors.read().unwrap();
        let count = *self.count.read().unwrap();
        
        let k = top_k as usize;
        
        // Compute distances - access vectors in a cache-friendly manner
        // Process vectors in order, keeping them in L1/L2 cache as we go
        let mut distances: Vec<(u64, f64)> = Vec::with_capacity(count);
        
        for i in 0..count {
            let id = ids[i];
            let vec_start = i * DIM;
            let vec = &vectors[vec_start..vec_start + DIM];
            let dist = l2_distance(query, vec);
            distances.push((id, dist));
        }
        
        // Partial sort to get top_k smallest distances
        if k >= distances.len() {
            distances.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
        } else {
            // Use select_nth_unstable to find the k smallest elements
            let mid = distances.as_mut_slice().select_nth_unstable_by(k, |a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
            // Sort only the first k elements
            mid.0.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
        }
        
        distances
            .into_iter()
            .take(k)
            .map(|(id, distance)| SearchResult { id, distance })
            .collect()
    }
}

const DIM: usize = 128;

pub struct VectorDB {
    // Flat storage for better cache locality
    ids: RwLock<Vec<u64>>,
    vectors: RwLock<Vec<f32>>,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        VectorDB {
            ids: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            vectors: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        let mut ids = self.ids.write().unwrap();
        let mut vectors = self.vectors.write().unwrap();
        
        ids.push(id);
        vectors.extend(vector);
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, new_vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut ids = self.ids.write().unwrap();
        let mut vectors = self.vectors.write().unwrap();
        
        let mut new_ids = Vec::with_capacity(new_vectors.len());
        let mut new_data = Vec::with_capacity(new_vectors.len() * DIM);
        
        for (id, vec) in new_vectors {
            new_ids.push(id);
            new_data.extend(vec);
        }
        
        let inserted = new_ids.len();
        ids.append(&mut new_ids);
        vectors.extend(new_data);
        
        inserted
    }

    pub fn search(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        let ids = self.ids.read().unwrap();

        let count = ids.len();
        
        let k = top_k as usize;
        
        // Use a max-heap to track top-k efficiently
        // This avoids sorting all 1M distances
        use std::collections::BinaryHeap;
        use std::cmp::Reverse;
        
        // Build max-heap of (distance, id) - we want to keep smallest k distances
        // So we store Reverse(distance) for min-heap behavior, or use max-heap with Reverse
        let mut heap: BinaryHeap<(Reverse<f64>, u64)> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
        
        for i in 0..count {
            let id = ids[i];
            let vec_start = i * DIM;
            let vec = &vectors[vec_start..vec_start + DIM];
            let dist = l2_distance(query, vec);
            
            if heap.len() < k {
                heap.push((Reverse(dist), id));
            } else if let Some(&(Reverse(max_dist), _)) = heap.peek() {
                if dist < max_dist {
                    heap.pop();
                    heap.push((Reverse(dist), id));
                }
            }

            .into_iter()
            .map(|(Reverse(dist), id)| SearchResult { id, distance: dist })
            .collect();
        
        // Sort by distance ascending
        results.sort_by(|a, b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap());
        
        results
    }
}

pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    debug_assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    
    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
    {
        if is_x86_feature_detected!("avx2") {
            return unsafe { l2_distance_avx2(a, b) };
        }
    }
    
    // Fallback to scalar
    let mut sum: f64 = 0.0;
    for i in 0..a.len() {
        let diff = (a[i] - b[i]) as f64;
        sum += diff * diff;
    }
    sum.sqrt()
}

    })

) -> Json<SearchResponse> {
    let results = db.search(&req.vector, req.top_k);

use std::collections::{HashMap, BinaryHeap};
use std::sync::RwLock;

pub struct VectorDB {
    data: RwLock<HashMap<u64, Vec<f32>>>,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            data: RwLock::new(HashMap::new())
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        let mut data = self.data.write().unwrap();
        data.insert(id, vector);
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut data = self.data.write().unwrap();
        let mut count = 0;
        for (id, vector) in vectors {
            data.insert(id, vector);
            count += 1;
        }
        count
    }

    pub fn search(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        let data = self.data.read().unwrap();
        let k = top_k as usize;

        let mut heap: BinaryHeap<(f64, u64)> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k);

        for (id, vector) in data.iter() {
            let dist = crate::l2_distance(query, vector);
            if heap.len() < k {
                heap.push((dist, *id));
            } else if let Some(&(max_dist, _)) = heap.peek() {
                if dist < max_dist {
                    let _ = heap.pop();
                    heap.push((dist, *id));
                }
            }
        }

        let mut results: Vec<SearchResult> = heap
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(dist, id)| SearchResult { id, distance: dist })
            .collect();

        results.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| {
            a.distance
                .partial_cmp(&b.distance)
                .expect("NaN distance")
        });

        results
    }

unsafe fn avx512_l2(query: &[f32], vec_base: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    let mut sum = 0.0f64;
    let mut i = 0usize;
    while i + 16 <= 128 {
        let q = _mm512_loadu_ps(query.as_ptr().add(i) as *const f32);
        let v = _mm512_loadu_ps(vec_base.as_ptr().add(i) as *const f32);
        let diff = _mm512_sub_ps(q, v);
        let sq = _mm512_mul_ps(diff, diff);
        sum += _mm512_reduce_add_ps(sq) as f64;
        i += 16;
    }
    sum.sqrt()
}

pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {

        for i in 0..128 {
            let d = (a[i] as f64 - b[i] as f64);
            sum += d * d;
        }
        sum.sqrt()
    }

    debug_assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    debug_assert_eq!(a.len(), 128);

    let mut sum_sq = _mm512_setzero_ps();

    let a_ptr = a.as_ptr();
    let b_ptr = b.as_ptr();

    for i in (0..128).step_by(16) {
        let va = _mm512_loadu_ps(a_ptr.add(i) as *const f32);
        let vb = _mm512_loadu_ps(b_ptr.add(i) as *const f32);
        let diff = _mm512_sub_ps(va, vb);
        let sq = _mm512_mul_ps(diff, diff);
        sum_sq = _mm512_add_ps(sum_sq, sq);
    }

    let sum_sq_f32 = reduce_add_ps(sum_sq);
    sum_sq_f32.sqrt() as f64
}

        let mut storage = self.storage.write().unwrap();
        let initial_len = storage.ids.len();
        storage.ids.reserve(vectors.len());
        storage.data.reserve(vectors.len() * 128);
        let mut count = 0;
        for (id, vector) in vectors {

                storage.data.extend(vector);

pub fn sq_l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {

        unsafe { sq_l2_avx512(a.as_ptr(), b.as_ptr()) }

#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f")]
unsafe fn sq_l2_avx512(aptr: *const f32, bptr: *const f32) -> f64 {
    let mut sum = 0.0f64;
    for i in 0..8 {
        let va = _mm512_loadu_ps(aptr.add(i * 16));
        let vb = _mm512_loadu_ps(bptr.add(i * 16));
        let diff = _mm512_sub_ps(va, vb);
        let sq = _mm512_mul_ps(diff, diff);
        sum += horizontal_sum(sq) as f64;
    }
    sum
}

unsafe fn horizontal_sum(v: __m512) -> f32 {
    let sum0 = _mm512_extractf32x4_ps::<0>(v);
    let sum1 = _mm512_extractf32x4_ps::<1>(v);
    let sum2 = _mm512_extractf32x4_ps::<2>(v);
    let sum3 = _mm512_extractf32x4_ps::<3>(v);
    let sum01 = _mm_add_ps(sum0, sum1);
    let sum23 = _mm_add_ps(sum2, sum3);
    let sum_ab = _mm_add_ps(sum01, sum23);
    let sum_high = _mm_movehl_ps(sum_ab, sum_ab);
    let sum_a = _mm_add_ps(sum_ab, sum_high);
    let sum_b = _mm_hadd_ps(sum_a, sum_a);
    let sum_c = _mm_hadd_ps(sum_b, sum_b);
    _mm_cvtss_f32(sum_c)
}

fn scalar_sq_l2(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    let mut sum = 0.0f64;
    for i in 0..128 {
        let d = (a[i] - b[i]) as f64;
        sum += d * d;
    }
    sum
}

use std::sync::RwLock;
use std::cmp::Ordering;

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Storage {
    ids: Vec<u64>,
    data: Vec<f32>,
}

pub struct VectorDB {
    storage: RwLock<Storage>,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            storage: RwLock::new(Storage {
                ids: Vec::new(),
                data: Vec::new(),
            }),
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        if vector.len() != 128 {
            return;
        }
        let mut storage = self.storage.write().unwrap();
        storage.ids.push(id);
        storage.data.extend_from_slice(&vector);
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, mut vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut storage = self.storage.write().unwrap();
        let initial_len = storage.ids.len();
        let reserve_count = vectors.len();
        storage.ids.reserve(reserve_count);
        storage.data.reserve(reserve_count * 128);
        let mut count = 0;
        for (id, vector) in vectors.drain(..) {
            if vector.len() == 128 {
                storage.ids.push(id);
                storage.data.extend_from_slice(&vector);
                count += 1;
            }
        }
        count
    }

    pub fn search(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        let storage = self.storage.read().unwrap();
        let n = storage.ids.len();
        let k = std::cmp::min(top_k as usize, n);
        if k == 0 || n == 0 {
            return vec![];
        }

        let num_threads = 4;
        let chunk_size = (n + num_threads - 1) / num_threads;
        let partial_topks: Vec<Vec<(f64, u64)>> = (0..num_threads).into_par_iter().map(|tid| {
            let start = tid * chunk_size;
            let end = std::cmp::min(start + chunk_size, n);
            let mut local_topk: Vec<(f64, u64)> = Vec::with_capacity(k);
            for i in start..end {
                let id = storage.ids[i];
                let offset = i * 128;
                let v_slice = unsafe {
                    std::slice::from_raw_parts(storage.data.as_ptr().add(offset), 128)
                };
                let sq_dist = sq_l2_distance(query, v_slice);
                let insert = if local_topk.len() < k {
                    true
                } else {
                    sq_dist < local_topk.last().unwrap().0
                };
                if insert {
                    if local_topk.len() == k {
                        local_topk.pop();
                    }
                    local_topk.push((sq_dist, id));
                    local_topk.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
                }
            }
            local_topk
        }).collect();

        let mut all_candidates: Vec<(f64, u64)> = partial_topks.into_iter().flatten().collect();
        all_candidates.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
        if all_candidates.len() > k {
            all_candidates.truncate(k);
        }

        all_candidates.into_iter()
            .map(|(sq_dist, id)| SearchResult {
                id,
                distance: sq_dist.sqrt(),
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

        let mut candidates: Vec<(f64, u64)> = Vec::with_capacity(num);

impl Ord for DistId {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {
        self.dist.total_cmp(&other.dist).then_with(|| self.id.cmp(&other.id))
    }
}

impl PartialOrd for DistId {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
        Some(self.cmp(other))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Storage {
    ids: Vec<u64>,
    vectors: Vec<f32>,
    dim: usize,
}

pub struct VectorDB {
    storage: RwLock<Storage>,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        // Set rayon to 4 threads
        let _ = rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder::new()
            .num_threads(4)
            .build_global();
        Self {
            storage: RwLock::new(Storage {
                ids: Vec::new(),
                vectors: Vec::new(),
                dim: 128,
            }),
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        let mut s = self.storage.write().unwrap();
        debug_assert_eq!(vector.len(), s.dim);
        s.ids.push(id);
        s.vectors.extend(vector);
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut s = self.storage.write().unwrap();
        let n = vectors.len();
        let mut total_elements = 0usize;
        for (_, ref v) in &vectors {
            debug_assert_eq!(v.len(), s.dim);
            total_elements += v.len();
        }
        s.vectors.reserve(total_elements);
        s.ids.reserve(n);
        for (id, v) in vectors {
            s.ids.push(id);
            s.vectors.extend(v);
        }
        n
    }

    pub fn search(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        debug_assert_eq!(query.len(), 128);
        let s = self.storage.read().unwrap();
        let num_vecs = s.ids.len();
        let k = std::cmp::min(top_k as usize, num_vecs);
        if k == 0 {
            return vec![];
        }
        let dim = s.dim;
        let n_threads = 4usize;
        let chunk_size = (num_vecs + n_threads - 1) / n_threads;

        let partial_topks: Vec<Vec<(f64, u64)>> = (0..n_threads)
            .into_par_iter()
            .map(|tid| {
                let start = tid * chunk_size;
                let end = std::cmp::min(start + chunk_size, num_vecs);
                let mut local_heap: BinaryHeap<DistId> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k);
                for ii in start..end {
                    let offset = ii * dim;
                    let db_vec = &s.vectors[offset..offset + dim];
                    let dist = crate::distance::l2_distance(query, db_vec);
                    let idd = s.ids[ii];
                    let new_item = DistId { dist, id: idd };
                    if local_heap.len() < k {
                        local_heap.push(new_item);
                    } else if let Some(top) = local_heap.peek() {
                        if dist < top.dist {
                            local_heap.pop();
                            local_heap.push(new_item);
                        }
                    }
                }
                let mut res: Vec<(f64, u64)> = local_heap.into_iter()
                    .map(|di| (di.dist, di.id))
                    .collect();
                res.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap());
                res
            })
            .collect();

        let mut all_candidates: Vec<(f64, u64)> = partial_topks.into_iter().flatten().collect();
        all_candidates.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap());
        all_candidates.truncate(k);
        all_candidates
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(dist, id)| SearchResult { id, distance: dist })
            .collect()
    }

// Requires AVX512F
#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f")]
#[inline]
unsafe fn avx512_l2_sq(a: *const f32, b: *const f32) -> f32 {
    let mut sum = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    let lanes = 128 / 16;
    for _ in 0..lanes {
        let qa = _mm512_loadu_ps(a);
        let qb = _mm512_loadu_ps(b);
        let diff = _mm512_sub_ps(qa, qb);
        sum = _mm512_fmadd_ps(diff, diff, sum);
        a = a.add(16);
        b = b.add(16);
    }
    _mm512_reduce_add_ps(sum)
}

pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    debug_assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    debug_assert_eq!(a.len(), 128);

        let sq_dist_f32 = avx512_l2_sq(a.as_ptr(), b.as_ptr());
        (sq_dist_f32 as f64).sqrt()
    }

## Task

Implement a vector database that:
- Stores 128-dimensional float32 vectors, each identified by a unique u64 ID
- Supports inserting individual vectors and bulk inserting multiple vectors at once
- Supports searching for the top-k nearest neighbors of a query vector using L2 (Euclidean) distance
- Returns search results sorted by L2 distance in ascending order (closest first)

## Project Structure

You are given a Rust project with the following files:

### Read-Only Files (DO NOT modify these)
- `src/main.rs` — HTTP server entry point. Defines routes and handlers for the three API endpoints. Uses axum with `Arc<VectorDB>` as shared state. Reads port from `PORT` env var (default 8080).
- `src/api.rs` — Request and response type definitions used by the API endpoints.

### Editable Files (YOUR implementation goes here)
- `src/db.rs` — Contains the `VectorDB` struct with stub methods that you must implement:

  - `bulk_insert(vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize` — Insert multiple vectors, return count inserted
  - `search(vector: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult>` — Find top-k nearest neighbors

- `Cargo.toml` — You may modify this to adjust release profile settings (e.g. `target-cpu`, `opt-level`) or add dependencies (e.g. `rayon` for parallelism). Do not add external vector search libraries. Keep `debug = true` in `[profile.release]` — it is required for profiling to show meaningful function names.

All stub methods currently contain `todo!()` and will panic until you provide an implementation.

## API Endpoints

### POST /insert
Request body: `{"id": 123, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.128]}`
Response: `{"status": "ok"}`

### POST /bulk_insert
Request body: `{"vectors": [{"id": 1, "vector": [...]}, {"id": 2, "vector": [...]}, ...]}`
Response: `{"status": "ok", "inserted": 100}`

### POST /search
Request body: `{"vector": [0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.128], "top_k": 10}`
Response: `{"results": [{"id": 45, "distance": 1.23}, {"id": 78, "distance": 2.45}, ...]}`
Results must be sorted by `distance` ascending (closest first).

## Evaluation Criteria

1. **Correctness (Recall):** Your top-10 results are compared against brute-force ground truth. Recall must be >= 95% to receive a score.
2. **Performance (QPS):** 10,000 queries with 4 concurrent threads. If recall < 95%, QPS score is 0.

Dataset: 1,000,000 base vectors (128-dim float32) and 10,000 query vectors. Data is loaded automatically by the benchmark tool via HTTP API — you do NOT need to read or access any data files.

**Runtime constraint:** Your server process is pinned to specific CPU cores via `taskset`. You have 4 dedicated cores available. Design your parallelism accordingly — using more than 4 threads will cause contention, not speedup.

## Hardware Environment

- **CPU:** Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY (Cascade Lake) @ 2.50GHz (turbo ~3.2GHz), dual-socket, 26 cores per socket
- **SIMD:** SSE4.2, AVX2, AVX-512 (AVX512F, AVX512BW, AVX512VL, AVX512DQ, AVX512CD, AVX512_VNNI)
- **L3 Cache:** 36 MB per socket
- **Memory:** ~1.5TB DDR4-2666, plenty of RAM — the entire dataset fits in memory
- **Storage:** Intel P3700 NVMe (not relevant since everything is in-memory)
- **Pinned cores:** 4 dedicated cores on a single NUMA node. All memory allocations will be local to this node.

Key optimization implications:
- AVX-512 is available and highly effective for 128-dim float32 distance calculations (128 floats = 512 bytes = 8 AVX-512 registers). Prefer AVX-512 intrinsics over AVX2 when possible.
- With 4 cores and 36MB L3 cache shared, cache-friendly memory layouts matter significantly.
- 1M vectors × 128 floats × 4 bytes = ~512MB raw data — fits in RAM but NOT in L3 cache. Index structures that reduce the search space are essential for high QPS.

use crate::distance::l2_distance;
use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::collections::BinaryHeap;
use std::sync::RwLock;

struct VectorEntry {
    id: u64,
    vector: Vec<f32>,
}

pub struct VectorDB {
    data: RwLock<Vec<VectorEntry>>,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            data: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        let mut data = self.data.write().unwrap();
        data.push(VectorEntry { id, vector });
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut data = self.data.write().unwrap();
        let count = vectors.len();
        data.extend(vectors.into_iter().map(|(id, vector)| VectorEntry { id, vector }));
        count
    }

    pub fn search(&self, vector: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        let data = self.data.read().unwrap();
        let k = top_k as usize;
        if k == 0 {
            return Vec::new();
        }

        let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapItem> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
        for entry in data.iter() {
            let distance = l2_distance(vector, &entry.vector);
            if heap.len() < k {
                heap.push(HeapItem { distance, id: entry.id });
            } else if let Some(top) = heap.peek() {
                if distance < top.distance {
                    heap.pop();
                    heap.push(HeapItem { distance, id: entry.id });
                }
            }
        }

        let mut results: Vec<SearchResult> = heap
            .into_iter()
            .map(|item| SearchResult {
                id: item.id,
                distance: item.distance,
            })
            .collect();
        results.sort_by(|a, b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
        results
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct HeapItem {
    distance: f64,
    id: u64,
}

impl Eq for HeapItem {}

impl PartialEq for HeapItem {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.distance == other.distance && self.id == other.id
    }
}

impl Ord for HeapItem {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {
        self.distance
            .partial_cmp(&other.distance)
            .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
    }
}

impl PartialOrd for HeapItem {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
        Some(self.cmp(other))

pub enum DistanceKind {
    Avx512,
    Avx2,
    Scalar,
}

pub fn select_distance_kind() -> DistanceKind {
    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
    {
        if std::is_x86_feature_detected!("avx512f") {
            return DistanceKind::Avx512;
        }
        if std::is_x86_feature_detected!("avx2") {
            return DistanceKind::Avx2;
        }
    }
    DistanceKind::Scalar
}

#[inline(always)]
pub fn l2_distance_scalar(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    let mut sum = 0.0f32;
    for (x, y) in a.iter().zip(b.iter()) {
        let diff = x - y;
        sum += diff * diff;
    }
    sum
}

#[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f")]
#[inline(always)]
pub unsafe fn l2_distance_avx512(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    use std::arch::x86_64::*;
    let mut sum = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i + 16 <= a.len() {
        let av = _mm512_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i));
        let bv = _mm512_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i));
        let diff = _mm512_sub_ps(av, bv);
        let prod = _mm512_mul_ps(diff, diff);
        sum = _mm512_add_ps(sum, prod);
        i += 16;
    }
    let mut total = _mm512_reduce_add_ps(sum);
    while i < a.len() {
        let diff = a.get_unchecked(i) - b.get_unchecked(i);
        total += diff * diff;
        i += 1;
    }
    total
}

#[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
#[target_feature(enable = "avx2")]
#[inline(always)]
pub unsafe fn l2_distance_avx2(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    use std::arch::x86_64::*;
    let mut sum = _mm256_setzero_ps();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i + 8 <= a.len() {
        let av = _mm256_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i));
        let bv = _mm256_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i));
        let diff = _mm256_sub_ps(av, bv);
        let prod = _mm256_mul_ps(diff, diff);
        sum = _mm256_add_ps(sum, prod);
        i += 8;
    }
    let mut tmp = [0f32; 8];
    _mm256_storeu_ps(tmp.as_mut_ptr(), sum);
    let mut total: f32 = tmp.iter().sum();
    while i < a.len() {
        let diff = a.get_unchecked(i) - b.get_unchecked(i);
        total += diff * diff;
        i += 1;
    }
    total
}

## Task

Implement a vector database that:
- Stores 128-dimensional float32 vectors, each identified by a unique u64 ID
- Supports inserting individual vectors and bulk inserting multiple vectors at once
- Supports searching for the top-k nearest neighbors of a query vector using L2 (Euclidean) distance
- Returns search results sorted by L2 distance in ascending order (closest first)

## Project Structure

You are given a Rust project with the following files:

### Read-Only Files (DO NOT modify these)
- `src/main.rs` — HTTP server entry point. Defines routes and handlers for the three API endpoints. Uses axum with `Arc<VectorDB>` as shared state. Reads port from `PORT` env var (default 8080).

### Editable Files (YOUR implementation goes here)
- `src/db.rs` — Contains the `VectorDB` struct with stub methods that you must implement:

  - `bulk_insert(vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize` — Insert multiple vectors, return count inserted
  - `search(vector: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult>` — Find top-k nearest neighbors

Do not add external vector search libraries. Keep `debug = true` in `[profile.release]` — it is required for profiling to show meaningful function names.

All stub methods currently contain `todo!()` and will panic until you provide an implementation.

## API Endpoints

### POST /insert

Response: `{"status": "ok"}`

### POST /bulk_insert
Request body: `{"vectors": [{"id": 1, "vector": [...]}, {"id": 2, "vector": [...]}, ...]}`

### POST /search
Request body: `{"vector": [0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.128], "top_k": 10}`
Response: `{"results": [{"id": 45, "distance": 1.23}, {"id": 78, "distance": 2.45}, ...]}`
Results must be sorted by `distance` ascending (closest first).

## Evaluation Criteria

1. **Correctness (Recall):** Your top-10 results are compared against brute-force ground truth. Recall must be >= 95% to receive a score.
2. **Performance (QPS):** 10,000 queries with 4 concurrent threads. If recall < 95%, QPS score is 0.

- **Memory:** ~1.5TB DDR4-2666, plenty of RAM — the entire dataset fits in memory
- **Storage:** Intel P3700 NVMe (not relevant since everything is in-memory)
- **Pinned cores:** 4 dedicated cores on a single NUMA node. All memory allocations will be local to this node.

Key optimization implications:
- AVX-512 is available and highly effective for 128-dim float32 distance calculations (128 floats = 512 bytes = 8 AVX-512 registers). Prefer AVX-512 intrinsics over AVX2 when possible.
- With 4 cores and 36MB L3 cache shared, cache-friendly memory layouts matter significantly.
- 1M vectors × 128 floats × 4 bytes = ~512MB raw data — fits in RAM but NOT in L3 cache. Index structures that reduce the search space are essential for high QPS.

**All build/server management is automatic.** Just focus on writing code and calling the test/benchmark/profiling tools.

use std::sync::RwLock;

pub struct VectorDB {
    ids: RwLock<Vec<u64>>,
    data: RwLock<Vec<f32>>, // flat storage, each vector 128 consecutive f32
    dim: usize,
}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            ids: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            data: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            dim: 128,
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        assert_eq!(vector.len(), self.dim);
        let mut ids = self.ids.write().unwrap();
        let mut data = self.data.write().unwrap();
        ids.push(id);
        data.extend_from_slice(&vector);
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let mut ids = self.ids.write().unwrap();
        let mut data = self.data.write().unwrap();
        let start = ids.len();
        for (id, vec) in vectors {
            assert_eq!(vec.len(), self.dim);
            ids.push(id);
            data.extend_from_slice(&vec);
        }
        ids.len() - start
    }

    pub fn search(&self, vector: &[f32], top_k: u32) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        assert_eq!(vector.len(), self.dim);
        let ids = self.ids.read().unwrap();
        let data = self.data.read().unwrap();
        let n = ids.len();
        let dim = self.dim;
        // Compute distances for all vectors
        let mut distances: Vec<(u64, f64)> = Vec::with_capacity(n);
        for i in 0..n {
            let start = i * dim;
            let dist = crate::distance::l2_distance(vector, &data[start..start + dim]);
            distances.push((ids[i], dist));
        }
        // Sort by distance ascending
        distances.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
        // Take top_k
        let k = top_k as usize;
        distances
            .into_iter()
            .take(k)
            .map(|(id, distance)| SearchResult { id, distance })
            .collect()
    }

// We compute squared distance in f64 precision and sqrt at the end.
pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    let n = a.len();

    // For 128-dim and AVX-512 available, use AVX-512 if target feature enabled.
    // We dispatch at runtime based on is_x86_feature_detected!.

        }
        if is_x86_feature_detected!("avx2") {
            return unsafe { l2_avx2(a, b) };
        }
    }

    // Scalar fallback
    let mut sum = 0.0f64;
    for i in 0..n {
        let diff = (a[i] as f64) - (b[i] as f64);
        sum += diff * diff;
    }
    sum.sqrt()
}

pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    let n = a.len();

    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
    {
        if is_x86_feature_detected!("avx512f") {
            return unsafe { l2_avx512(a, b) };
        }
        if is_x86_feature_detected!("avx2") {
            return unsafe { l2_avx2(a, b) };
        }
    }

    // Scalar fallback with fused multiply-add via manual loop
    let mut sum = 0.0f64;
    for i in 0..n {
        let diff = (a[i] as f64) - (b[i] as f64);
        sum += diff * diff;
    }
    sum.sqrt()
}

#[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
#[target_feature(enable = "avx512f")]
unsafe fn l2_avx512(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    let n = a.len();
    let mut i = 0;
    // Use 4 accumulators to hide latency
    let mut acc0 = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    let mut acc1 = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    let mut acc2 = _mm512_setzero_ps();
    let mut acc3 = _mm512_setzero_ps();

    while i + 64 <= n {
        let va0 = _mm512_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i));
        let vb0 = _mm512_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i));
        let diff0 = _mm512_sub_ps(va0, vb0);
        acc0 = _mm512_fmadd_ps(diff0, diff0, acc0);

        let va1 = _mm512_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i + 16));
        let vb1 = _mm512_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i + 16));
        let diff1 = _mm512_sub_ps(va1, vb1);
        acc1 = _mm512_fmadd_ps(diff1, diff1, acc1);

        let va2 = _mm512_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i + 32));
        let vb2 = _mm512_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i + 32));
        let diff2 = _mm512_sub_ps(va2, vb2);
        acc2 = _mm512_fmadd_ps(diff2, diff2, acc2);

        let va3 = _mm512_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i + 48));
        let vb3 = _mm512_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i + 48));
        let diff3 = _mm512_sub_ps(va3, vb3);
        acc3 = _mm512_fmadd_ps(diff3, diff3, acc3);

        i += 64;
    }

    // Handle remaining 32 elements
    if i + 32 <= n {
        let va0 = _mm512_loadu_ps(a.as_ptr().add(i));
        let vb0 = _mm512_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i));
        let diff0 = _mm512_sub_ps(va0, vb0);
        acc0 = _mm512_fmadd_ps(diff0, diff0, acc0);
        i += 32;
    }

    // Combine accumulators
    let sum_ps = _mm512_add_ps(_mm512_add_ps(acc0, acc1), _mm512_add_ps(acc2, acc3));
    let mut sum = _mm512_reduce_add_ps(sum_ps) as f64;

    // Tail
    while i < n {
        let diff = (a[i] as f64) - (b[i] as f64);
        sum += diff * diff;
        i += 1;
    }

    sum.sqrt()
}

#[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
#[target_feature(enable = "avx2")]
unsafe fn l2_avx2(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {

    let mut i = 0;

        acc1 = _mm256_fmadd_ps(diff1, diff1, acc1);

        acc2 = _mm256_fmadd_ps(diff2, diff2, acc2);

        let vb3 = _mm256_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i + 24));
        let diff3 = _mm256_sub_ps(va3, vb3);
        acc3 = _mm256_fmadd_ps(diff3, diff3, acc3);

        i += 32;
    }

    // Handle remaining 16 elements

        let vb0 = _mm256_loadu_ps(b.as_ptr().add(i));
        let diff0 = _mm256_sub_ps(va0, vb0);
        acc0 = _mm256_fmadd_ps(diff0, diff0, acc0);
        i += 16;
    }

    let sum_ps = _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_add_ps(acc0, acc1), _mm256_add_ps(acc2, acc3));

        sum += diff * diff;
        i += 1;
    }

    sum.sqrt()

unsafe fn horizontal_sum_ps(v: __m256) -> f32 {

    let v64 = _mm_add_ss(v64, _mm_shuffle_ps(v64, v64, 0x1));
    _mm_cvtss_f32(v64)
}

/// Simple top-k tracker using a small array (for k ~ 10)
struct TopK {
    items: Vec<(f32, u64)>,
    k: usize,
    worst: f32,
    worst_idx: usize,
}

impl TopK {
    fn new(k: usize) -> Self {
        TopK {
            items: Vec::with_capacity(k),
            k,
            worst: f32::INFINITY,
            worst_idx: 0,
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn push(&mut self, dist: f32, id: u64) {
        if self.items.len() < self.k {
            self.items.push((dist, id));
            if self.items.len() == self.k {
                self.recompute_worst();
            }
        } else if dist < self.worst {
            self.items[self.worst_idx] = (dist, id);
            self.recompute_worst();
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn recompute_worst(&mut self) {
        let mut widx = 0;
        let mut wdist = self.items[0].0;
        for i in 1..self.items.len() {
            if self.items[i].0 > wdist {
                wdist = self.items[i].0;
                widx = i;
            }
        }
        self.worst = wdist;
        self.worst_idx = widx;
    }
    
    fn into_results(mut self) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        self.items.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap());
        self.items.iter().map(|&(dist, id)| SearchResult {
            id,
            distance: dist as f64,
        }).collect()
    }
}

#[inline(always)]
fn find_nearest_centroid(vec: &[f32], centroids: &[f32], num_clusters: usize) -> usize {
    let mut best_idx = 0;
    let mut best_dist = f32::INFINITY;
    for c in 0..num_clusters {
        let centroid = &centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM];
        let dist = l2_distance_f32(vec, centroid);
        if dist < best_dist {
            best_dist = dist;
            best_idx = c;
        }
    }
    best_idx
}

fn kmeans_clustering(vecs: &[f32], n: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
    let sample_size = n.min(KMEANS_SAMPLE_SIZE);
    
    // Deterministic sampling: take evenly spaced vectors
    let step = if sample_size < n { n / sample_size } else { 1 };
    let sample_indices: Vec<usize> = (0..sample_size).map(|i| (i * step).min(n - 1)).collect();
    
    // Build contiguous sample data for faster access
    let mut sample_data = vec![0.0f32; sample_size * DIM];
    for (si, &idx) in sample_indices.iter().enumerate() {
        sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&vecs[idx * DIM..(idx + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    // Initialize centroids: pick evenly spaced from samples
    let mut centroids = vec![0.0f32; NUM_CLUSTERS * DIM];
    let centroid_step = sample_size / NUM_CLUSTERS;
    for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
        let src = c * centroid_step;
        centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&sample_data[src * DIM..(src + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    // K-means iterations
    for _iter in 0..KMEANS_ITERS {
        // Assign samples to clusters (parallel)
        let assignments: Vec<usize> = (0..sample_size).into_par_iter().map(|si| {
            let vec_data = &sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM];
            find_nearest_centroid(vec_data, &centroids, NUM_CLUSTERS)
        }).collect();
        
        // Recompute centroids
        let mut new_centroids = vec![0.0f64; NUM_CLUSTERS * DIM];
        let mut counts = vec![0usize; NUM_CLUSTERS];
        
        for (si, &cluster_id) in assignments.iter().enumerate() {
            counts[cluster_id] += 1;
            let src_offset = si * DIM;
            for d in 0..DIM {
                new_centroids[cluster_id * DIM + d] += sample_data[src_offset + d] as f64;
            }
        }
        
        for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
            if counts[c] > 0 {
                let inv = 1.0 / counts[c] as f64;
                for d in 0..DIM {
                    centroids[c * DIM + d] = (new_centroids[c * DIM + d] * inv) as f32;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    centroids
}

/// Compute L2 squared distance for 128-dim f32 vectors using AVX-512.
#[inline(always)]
pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    l2_distance_f32(a, b) as f64

#[inline(always)]
pub fn l2_distance_f32(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {

    }

/// Compute L2 squared distance with early exit if exceeds threshold.
/// Returns the distance if <= threshold, or a value > threshold otherwise.
#[inline(always)]
pub fn l2_distance_f32_early(a: &[f32], b: &[f32], threshold: f32) -> f32 {
    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]

/// Simple top-k tracker using a small array (for k ~ 10)
struct TopK {
    items: Vec<(f32, u64)>,
    k: usize,
    worst: f32,
    worst_idx: usize,
}

impl TopK {
    #[inline]
    fn new(k: usize) -> Self {
        TopK {
            items: Vec::with_capacity(k),
            k,
            worst: f32::INFINITY,
            worst_idx: 0,
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn push(&mut self, dist: f32, id: u64) {
        if self.items.len() < self.k {
            self.items.push((dist, id));
            if self.items.len() == self.k {
                self.recompute_worst();
            }
        } else if dist < self.worst {
            unsafe { *self.items.get_unchecked_mut(self.worst_idx) = (dist, id); }
            self.recompute_worst();
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn recompute_worst(&mut self) {
        let mut widx = 0;
        let mut wdist = self.items[0].0;
        for i in 1..self.items.len() {
            let d = unsafe { self.items.get_unchecked(i).0 };
            if d > wdist {
                wdist = d;
                widx = i;
            }
        }
        self.worst = wdist;
        self.worst_idx = widx;
    }
    
    fn into_results(mut self) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        self.items.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap());
        self.items.iter().map(|&(dist, id)| SearchResult {
            id,
            distance: dist as f64,
        }).collect()
    }
}

#[inline(always)]
fn find_nearest_centroid(vec: &[f32], centroids: &[f32], num_clusters: usize) -> usize {
    let mut best_idx = 0;
    let mut best_dist = f32::INFINITY;
    for c in 0..num_clusters {
        let centroid = &centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM];
        let dist = l2_distance_f32(vec, centroid);
        if dist < best_dist {
            best_dist = dist;
            best_idx = c;
        }
    }
    best_idx
}

fn kmeans_clustering(vecs: &[f32], n: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
    let sample_size = n.min(KMEANS_SAMPLE_SIZE);
    let step = if sample_size < n { n / sample_size } else { 1 };
    
    // Build contiguous sample data
    let mut sample_data = vec![0.0f32; sample_size * DIM];
    for si in 0..sample_size {
        let idx = (si * step).min(n - 1);
        sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&vecs[idx * DIM..(idx + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    // Initialize centroids: evenly spaced from samples
    let mut centroids = vec![0.0f32; NUM_CLUSTERS * DIM];
    let centroid_step = sample_size / NUM_CLUSTERS;
    for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
        let src = c * centroid_step;
        centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&sample_data[src * DIM..(src + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    for _iter in 0..KMEANS_ITERS {
        let assignments: Vec<usize> = (0..sample_size).into_par_iter().map(|si| {
            find_nearest_centroid(&sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM], &centroids, NUM_CLUSTERS)
        }).collect();
        
        let mut new_centroids = vec![0.0f64; NUM_CLUSTERS * DIM];
        let mut counts = vec![0u32; NUM_CLUSTERS];
        
        for (si, &cluster_id) in assignments.iter().enumerate() {
            counts[cluster_id] += 1;
            let src_offset = si * DIM;
            for d in 0..DIM {
                new_centroids[cluster_id * DIM + d] += sample_data[src_offset + d] as f64;
            }
        }
        
        for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
            if counts[c] > 0 {
                let inv = 1.0 / counts[c] as f64;
                for d in 0..DIM {
                    centroids[c * DIM + d] = (new_centroids[c * DIM + d] * inv) as f32;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    centroids
}

#[inline(always)]
fn find_nearest_centroid(vec: &[f32], centroids: &[f32], num_clusters: usize) -> usize {
    let mut best_idx = 0;
    let mut best_dist = f32::INFINITY;
    for c in 0..num_clusters {
        let dist = l2_distance_f32(vec, &centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM]);
        if dist < best_dist {
            best_dist = dist;
            best_idx = c;
        }
    }
    best_idx
}

fn kmeans_clustering(vecs: &[f32], n: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
    let sample_size = n.min(KMEANS_SAMPLE_SIZE);
    let step = if sample_size < n { n / sample_size } else { 1 };
    
    let mut sample_data = vec![0.0f32; sample_size * DIM];
    for si in 0..sample_size {
        let idx = (si * step).min(n - 1);
        sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&vecs[idx * DIM..(idx + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    let mut centroids = vec![0.0f32; NUM_CLUSTERS * DIM];
    let centroid_step = sample_size / NUM_CLUSTERS;
    for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
        let src = (c * centroid_step).min(sample_size - 1);
        centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&sample_data[src * DIM..(src + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    for _iter in 0..KMEANS_ITERS {
        let assignments: Vec<usize> = (0..sample_size).into_par_iter().map(|si| {
            find_nearest_centroid(&sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM], &centroids, NUM_CLUSTERS)

        let mut new_centroids = vec![0.0f64; NUM_CLUSTERS * DIM];
        let mut counts = vec![0u32; NUM_CLUSTERS];
        
        for (si, &cluster_id) in assignments.iter().enumerate() {
            counts[cluster_id] += 1;
            let src_offset = si * DIM;
            for d in 0..DIM {
                new_centroids[cluster_id * DIM + d] += sample_data[src_offset + d] as f64;

        for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
            if counts[c] > 0 {
                let inv = 1.0 / counts[c] as f64;
                for d in 0..DIM {
                    centroids[c * DIM + d] = (new_centroids[c * DIM + d] * inv) as f32;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    centroids
}

    ids: Vec<u64>,
    data: Vec<f32>,
    norms: Vec<f32>,  // precomputed ||v||^2 for each vector
}

unsafe impl Send for IVFIndex {}
unsafe impl Sync for IVFIndex {}

impl VectorDB {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder::new()
            .num_threads(4)
            .build_global()
            .ok();
        
        VectorDB {
            vectors: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            ids: RwLock::new(Vec::new()),
            index: RwLock::new(None),
            index_built: AtomicBool::new(false),
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {
        let mut vecs = self.vectors.write();
        let mut ids = self.ids.write();
        vecs.extend_from_slice(&vector);
        ids.push(id);
        self.index_built.store(false, Ordering::Release);
    }

    pub fn bulk_insert(&self, vectors: Vec<(u64, Vec<f32>)>) -> usize {
        let n = vectors.len();

            let mut vecs = self.vectors.write();
            let mut ids = self.ids.write();
            vecs.reserve(n * DIM);
            ids.reserve(n);
            for (id, vector) in &vectors {
                vecs.extend_from_slice(vector);
                ids.push(*id);
            }
        }
        self.index_built.store(false, Ordering::Release);
        n
    }

    fn ensure_index_built(&self) {
        if self.index_built.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
            return;
        }
        self.build_ivf_index();
    }

    fn build_ivf_index(&self) {
        let vecs = self.vectors.read();
        let ids_guard = self.ids.read();
        let n = ids_guard.len();
        
        if n < NUM_CLUSTERS * 2 {
            self.index_built.store(true, Ordering::Release);
            return;
        }
        
        let centroids = kmeans_clustering(&vecs, n);
        
        // Precompute centroid norms
        let centroid_norms: Vec<f32> = (0..NUM_CLUSTERS).map(|c| {
            squared_norm_f32(&centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM])
        }).collect();
        
        let assignments: Vec<u16> = (0..n).into_par_iter().map(|i| {
            find_nearest_centroid(&vecs[i * DIM..(i + 1) * DIM], &centroids, NUM_CLUSTERS) as u16
        }).collect();
        
        let mut sizes = vec![0usize; NUM_CLUSTERS];
        for &a in &assignments {
            sizes[a as usize] += 1;
        }
        
        let mut clusters: Vec<Cluster> = sizes.iter().map(|&s| Cluster {
            ids: Vec::with_capacity(s),
            data: Vec::with_capacity(s * DIM),
            norms: Vec::with_capacity(s),
        }).collect();
        
        for (i, &cluster_id) in assignments.iter().enumerate() {
            let c = cluster_id as usize;
            clusters[c].ids.push(ids_guard[i]);

            clusters[c].data.extend_from_slice(vec_slice);
            clusters[c].norms.push(squared_norm_f32(vec_slice));

        if let Some(ref index) = *index_guard {

        self.brute_force_search(vector, top_k)
    }
    
    fn brute_force_search(&self, query: &[f32], top_k: usize) -> Vec<SearchResult> {

        }
        heap.into_results()
    }

#[inline(never)]
fn ivf_search(query: &[f32], top_k: usize, index: &IVFIndex) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    let query_norm = squared_norm_f32(query);
    
    // Compute distances to all centroids using: ||q-c||^2 = ||q||^2 + ||c||^2 - 2*q·c
    let mut centroid_dists: Vec<(u16, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(NUM_CLUSTERS);
    for c in 0..NUM_CLUSTERS {
        let dot = dot_product_f32(query, &index.centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM]);
        let dist = query_norm + index.centroid_norms[c] - 2.0 * dot;
        centroid_dists.push((c as u16, dist));
    }
    
    // Select top NPROBE
    centroid_dists.select_nth_unstable_by(NPROBE - 1, |a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
    
    let mut heap = TopK::new(top_k);
    
    for i in 0..NPROBE {
        let cluster_id = centroid_dists[i].0 as usize;
        let cluster = &index.clusters[cluster_id];
        let count = cluster.ids.len();
        if count == 0 { continue; }
        
        let data = &cluster.data;
        let ids = &cluster.ids;
        let norms = &cluster.norms;
        
        for j in 0..count {
            // Use norm-based distance: ||q-v||^2 = ||q||^2 + ||v||^2 - 2*q·v
            let dot = dot_product_f32(query, unsafe {
                data.get_unchecked(j * DIM..(j + 1) * DIM)
            });
            let dist = query_norm + unsafe { *norms.get_unchecked(j) } - 2.0 * dot;
            if dist < heap.worst || heap.items.len() < heap.k {
                heap.push_unchecked(dist, unsafe { *ids.get_unchecked(j) });
            }
        }
    }
    
    heap.into_results()
}

#[inline(never)]
fn ivf_search(query: &[f32], top_k: usize, index: &IVFIndex) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    // Step 1: Find nearest super-clusters (only 64 distance computations)
    let mut super_dists: Vec<(u8, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(NUM_SUPER_CLUSTERS);
    for sc in 0..NUM_SUPER_CLUSTERS {
        let dist = l2_distance_f32(query, &index.super_centroids[sc * DIM..(sc + 1) * DIM]);
        super_dists.push((sc as u8, dist));
    }
    super_dists.select_nth_unstable_by(SUPER_NPROBE - 1, |a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
    
    // Step 2: Within selected super-clusters, find nearest centroids
    // Collect candidate centroids from top super-clusters
    let mut candidate_centroids: Vec<(u16, f32)> = Vec::with_capacity(SUPER_NPROBE * (NUM_CLUSTERS / NUM_SUPER_CLUSTERS + 10));
    for i in 0..SUPER_NPROBE {
        let sc = super_dists[i].0 as usize;
        for &cid in &index.super_members[sc] {
            let dist = l2_distance_f32(query, &index.centroids[cid as usize * DIM..(cid as usize + 1) * DIM]);
            candidate_centroids.push((cid, dist));
        }
    }
    
    // Select top NPROBE from candidates
    let actual_nprobe = NPROBE.min(candidate_centroids.len());
    if actual_nprobe == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    candidate_centroids.select_nth_unstable_by(actual_nprobe - 1, |a, b| a.1.partial_cmp(&b.1).unwrap());
    
    let mut heap = TopK::new(top_k);
    
    for i in 0..actual_nprobe {
        let cluster_id = candidate_centroids[i].0 as usize;
        let cluster = &index.clusters[cluster_id];
        let count = cluster.ids.len();
        if count == 0 { continue; }
        
        let data = &cluster.data;
        let ids = &cluster.ids;
        
        for j in 0..count {
            let offset = j * DIM;
            let dist = l2_distance_f32(query, unsafe {
                data.get_unchecked(offset..offset + DIM)
            });
            if dist < heap.worst || heap.items.len() < heap.k {
                heap.push_unchecked(dist, unsafe { *ids.get_unchecked(j) });
            }
        }
    }
    
    heap.into_results()
}

struct TopK {
    items: Vec<(f32, u64)>,
    k: usize,
    worst: f32,
    worst_idx: usize,
}

impl TopK {
    #[inline]
    fn new(k: usize) -> Self {
        TopK {
            items: Vec::with_capacity(k),
            k,
            worst: f32::INFINITY,
            worst_idx: 0,
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn push(&mut self, dist: f32, id: u64) {
        if self.items.len() < self.k {
            self.items.push((dist, id));
            if self.items.len() == self.k {
                self.recompute_worst();
            }
        } else if dist < self.worst {
            unsafe { *self.items.get_unchecked_mut(self.worst_idx) = (dist, id); }
            self.recompute_worst();
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn push_unchecked(&mut self, dist: f32, id: u64) {
        if self.items.len() < self.k {
            self.items.push((dist, id));
            if self.items.len() == self.k {
                self.recompute_worst();
            }
        } else {
            unsafe { *self.items.get_unchecked_mut(self.worst_idx) = (dist, id); }
            self.recompute_worst();
        }
    }
    
    #[inline(always)]
    fn recompute_worst(&mut self) {
        let mut widx = 0;
        let mut wdist = unsafe { self.items.get_unchecked(0).0 };
        for i in 1..self.items.len() {
            let d = unsafe { self.items.get_unchecked(i).0 };
            if d > wdist {
                wdist = d;
                widx = i;
            }
        }
        self.worst = wdist;
        self.worst_idx = widx;
    }
    
    fn into_results(mut self) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
        self.items.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap());
        self.items.iter().map(|&(dist, id)| SearchResult {
            id,
            distance: dist as f64,
        }).collect()
    }
}

#[inline(always)]
fn find_nearest_centroid(vec: &[f32], centroids: &[f32], num_clusters: usize) -> usize {
    let mut best_idx = 0;
    let mut best_dist = f32::INFINITY;
    for c in 0..num_clusters {
        let dist = l2_distance_f32(vec, &centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM]);
        if dist < best_dist {
            best_dist = dist;
            best_idx = c;
        }
    }
    best_idx
}

fn kmeans_clustering(vecs: &[f32], n: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
    let sample_size = n.min(KMEANS_SAMPLE_SIZE);
    let step = if sample_size < n { n / sample_size } else { 1 };
    
    let mut sample_data = vec![0.0f32; sample_size * DIM];
    for si in 0..sample_size {
        let idx = (si * step).min(n - 1);
        sample_data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&vecs[idx * DIM..(idx + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    kmeans_local(&sample_data, sample_size, NUM_CLUSTERS, KMEANS_ITERS)
}

fn kmeans_local(data: &[f32], n: usize, num_clusters: usize, iters: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
    let actual_clusters = num_clusters.min(n);
    let mut centroids = vec![0.0f32; num_clusters * DIM];
    let centroid_step = (n / actual_clusters).max(1);
    for c in 0..actual_clusters {
        let src = (c * centroid_step).min(n - 1);
        centroids[c * DIM..(c + 1) * DIM].copy_from_slice(&data[src * DIM..(src + 1) * DIM]);
    }
    
    for _iter in 0..iters {
        // For large datasets use parallel, for small use sequential
        let assignments: Vec<usize> = if n > 10000 {
            (0..n).into_par_iter().map(|si| {
                find_nearest_centroid(&data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM], &centroids, num_clusters)
            }).collect()
        } else {
            (0..n).map(|si| {
                find_nearest_centroid(&data[si * DIM..(si + 1) * DIM], &centroids, num_clusters)
            }).collect()
        };
        
        let mut new_centroids = vec![0.0f64; num_clusters * DIM];
        let mut counts = vec![0u32; num_clusters];
        
        for (si, &cluster_id) in assignments.iter().enumerate() {
            counts[cluster_id] += 1;
            let src_offset = si * DIM;
            for d in 0..DIM {
                new_centroids[cluster_id * DIM + d] += data[src_offset + d] as f64;
            }
        }
        
        for c in 0..num_clusters {
            if counts[c] > 0 {
                let inv = 1.0 / counts[c] as f64;
                for d in 0..DIM {
                    centroids[c * DIM + d] = (new_centroids[c * DIM + d] * inv) as f32;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    centroids
}

pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {
    debug_assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
    l2_distance_f32(a, b) as f64
}

/// Squared L2 distance returning f32 accumulator (for speed).
#[inline(always)]
pub fn l2_distance_f32(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
    {
        if is_x86_feature_detected!("avx512f") {
            return unsafe { l2_distance_avx512(a, b) };
        }
        if is_x86_feature_detected!("avx2") {
            return unsafe { l2_distance_avx2(a, b) };
        }
    }

fn build_ivf(inner: &mut Inner) {

    let mut centroids = Vec::<f32>::with_capacity(n_clusters * 128);
    let step = n / n_clusters;

            for j in 0..128 {

            }

            let cen = &mut centroids[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];

    let chunk_size = (n + 3) / 4;

        .into_par_iter()
        .map(|chunk_id| {
            let start = chunk_id * chunk_size;

            if start >= end {
                return Vec::new();
            }
            let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
            for i in start..end {
                let v = store.get_vec(i);
                let d = l2_distance_f32(query, v);
                let entry = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: store.ids[i] };
                if heap.len() < k {
                    heap.push(entry);
                } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
                    heap.pop();
                    heap.push(entry);
                }
            }
            heap.into_iter().map(|e| (e.dist.0, e.id)).collect()
        })
        .collect();

    // Merge results from chunks
    let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
    for chunk in results {
        for (d, id) in chunk {

            if heap.len() < k {
                heap.push(entry);
            } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
                heap.pop();
                heap.push(entry);
            }
        }
    }

    let mut out: Vec<SearchResult> = heap
        .into_iter()
        .map(|e| SearchResult { id: e.id, distance: e.dist.0 as f64 })
        .collect();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    out
}

/// Build the IVF index using k-means on the stored vectors.
fn build_ivf(inner: &mut Inner) {
    let n = inner.store.len();
    let n_clusters = N_CLUSTERS.min(n);

    eprintln!("Building IVF index: {} clusters, {} vectors", n_clusters, n);

    // Initialize centroids: sample evenly
    let mut centroids = Vec::<f32>::with_capacity(n_clusters * 128);
    let step = n / n_clusters;
    for i in 0..n_clusters {
        let idx = i * step;
        centroids.extend_from_slice(inner.store.get_vec(idx));
    }

    let mut assignments = vec![0u32; n];

    for iter in 0..KMEANS_ITERS {
        // Parallel assignment
        let store_data = &inner.store.data;
        let centroids_snap = centroids.clone();
        let new_assignments: Vec<u32> = (0..n)
            .into_par_iter()
            .map(|i| {
                let v = &store_data[i * 128..(i + 1) * 128];
                let mut best_dist = f32::MAX;
                let mut best_c = 0u32;
                for c in 0..n_clusters {
                    let cen = &centroids_snap[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
                    let d = l2_distance_f32(v, cen);
                    if d < best_dist {
                        best_dist = d;
                        best_c = c as u32;
                    }
                }
                best_c
            })
            .collect();

        let changed = assignments
            .iter()
            .zip(new_assignments.iter())
            .filter(|(a, b)| a != b)
            .count();
        assignments = new_assignments;

        // Update centroids
        // Use parallel reduction per cluster
        // Accumulate with f64 for stability
        let mut sums = vec![0.0f64; n_clusters * 128];
        let mut counts = vec![0u32; n_clusters];

        for i in 0..n {
            let c = assignments[i] as usize;
            counts[c] += 1;
            let v = inner.store.get_vec(i);
            let sum_slice = &mut sums[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
            for j in 0..128 {
                sum_slice[j] += v[j] as f64;
            }
        }

        for c in 0..n_clusters {
            let cnt = (counts[c] as f64).max(1.0);
            let cen = &mut centroids[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
            let sum_slice = &sums[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
            for j in 0..128 {
                cen[j] = (sum_slice[j] / cnt) as f32;
            }
        }

        eprintln!("  iter {}/{}: {} changed", iter + 1, KMEANS_ITERS, changed);
        if changed == 0 {
            break;
        }
    }

    // Build inverted lists
    let mut lists: Vec<Vec<u32>> = vec![Vec::new(); n_clusters];
    for (i, &c) in assignments.iter().enumerate() {
        lists[c as usize].push(i as u32);
    }

    inner.ivf.lists = lists;
    inner.ivf.built = true;

    eprintln!("IVF built. Avg list size: {}", avg_list_size);
}

/// Brute-force search (parallel across 4 threads)
fn search_brute_force(store: &VectorStore, query: &[f32], k: usize) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    let n = store.len();
    let k = k.min(n);
    if k == 0 { return Vec::new(); }

    let chunk_size = (n + 3) / 4;
    let results: Vec<Vec<(f32, u64)>> = (0..4)
        .into_par_iter()
        .map(|chunk_id| {
            let start = chunk_id * chunk_size;
            let end = (start + chunk_size).min(n);
            if start >= end { return Vec::new(); }
            top_k_in_range(&store.data, &store.ids, start, end, query, k)
        })
        .collect();

    merge_results(results, k)
}

/// IVF search: probe nearest centroids and search their lists
fn search_ivf(inner: &Inner, query: &[f32], k: usize) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    let n_probes = N_PROBES;
    let probe_list = inner.ivf.nearest_centroids(query, n_probes);

    // Gather candidate indices
    let mut candidates: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    for &cid in &probe_list {
        candidates.extend_from_slice(&inner.ivf.lists[cid]);
    }

    let n = candidates.len();
    let k = k.min(n);
    if k == 0 { return Vec::new(); }

    // Search candidates in parallel chunks
    let chunk_size = (n + 3) / 4;
    let results: Vec<Vec<(f32, u64)>> = (0..4)
        .into_par_iter()
        .map(|chunk_id| {
            let start = chunk_id * chunk_size;
            let end = (start + chunk_size).min(n);
            if start >= end { return Vec::new(); }

            let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
            for i in start..end {
                let idx = candidates[i] as usize;
                let v = inner.store.get_vec(idx);
                let d = l2_distance_f32(query, v);
                let entry = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: inner.store.ids[idx] };
                if heap.len() < k {
                    heap.push(entry);
                } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
                    heap.pop();
                    heap.push(entry);
                }
            }
            heap.into_iter().map(|e| (e.dist.0, e.id)).collect()
        })
        .collect();

    merge_results(results, k)
}

/// Find top-k in a contiguous range of the flat data array
#[inline]
fn top_k_in_range(
    data: &[f32],
    ids: &[u64],
    start: usize,
    end: usize,
    query: &[f32],
    k: usize,
) -> Vec<(f32, u64)> {
    let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
    for i in start..end {
        let v = &data[i * 128..(i + 1) * 128];
        let d = l2_distance_f32(query, v);
        let entry = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: ids[i] };
        if heap.len() < k {
            heap.push(entry);
        } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
            heap.pop();
            heap.push(entry);
        }
    }
    heap.into_iter().map(|e| (e.dist.0, e.id)).collect()
}

/// Merge results from parallel chunks into final sorted top-k
fn merge_results(chunks: Vec<Vec<(f32, u64)>>, k: usize) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
    for chunk in chunks {
        for (d, id) in chunk {
            let entry = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id };
            if heap.len() < k {
                heap.push(entry);
            } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
                heap.pop();
                heap.push(entry);
            }
        }
    }

    let mut out: Vec<SearchResult> = heap
        .into_iter()
        .map(|e| SearchResult { id: e.id, distance: e.dist.0 as f64 })
        .collect();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    out
}

    let per_chunk: Vec<Vec<(f32, usize)>> = (0..4)
        .into_par_iter()
        .map(|ci| {
            let start = ci * chunk_size;
            let end = (start + chunk_size).min(n);
            if start >= end { return Vec::new(); }
            let ptr = cen_ptr as *const f32;
            let mut best: Vec<(f32, usize)> = Vec::with_capacity(n_probes + 1);
            let mut worst = f32::MAX;
            for i in start..end {

fn build_ivf(inner: &mut Inner) {
    let n = inner.store.len();
    let n_clusters = N_CLUSTERS.min(n);
    eprintln!("[IVF] Building: {} clusters, {} vectors", n_clusters, n);

    // Init: sample evenly-spaced vectors as initial centroids
    let mut centroids: Vec<f32> = Vec::with_capacity(n_clusters * 128);
    let step = n / n_clusters;
    for i in 0..n_clusters {

        let cen_ptr = centroids.as_ptr() as usize;
        let nc = n_clusters;

            .into_par_iter()

                let mut best_d = f32::MAX;
                let mut best_c = 0u32;

        let mut sums = vec![0.0f32; n_clusters * 128];

            let s = &mut sums[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
            for j in 0..128 { s[j] += v[j]; }
        }
        for c in 0..n_clusters {
            let cnt = counts[c].max(1) as f32;
            let cen = &mut centroids[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
            let s = &sums[c * 128..(c + 1) * 128];
            for j in 0..128 { cen[j] = s[j] / cnt; }
        }

        eprintln!("[IVF] iter {}/{}: {} changed", iter + 1, KMEANS_ITERS, changed);
        if changed == 0 { break; }
    }

    let mut lists: Vec<Vec<u32>> = (0..n_clusters).map(|_| Vec::new()).collect();

    inner.ivf.lists = lists;
    inner.ivf.built = true;

fn nearest_centroids(ivf: &IvfIndex, query: &[f32], n_probes: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
    let n = ivf.centroids.len() / 128;

    for i in 0..n {
        let cen = &ivf.centroids[i * 128..(i + 1) * 128];
        let d = l2_distance_f32(query, cen);
        let e = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: i as u64 };
        if heap.len() < n_probes {

        } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
            heap.pop();
            heap.push(e);
        }
    }
    let mut v: Vec<(f32, usize)> = heap.into_iter().map(|e| (e.dist.0, e.id as usize)).collect();

    v.into_iter().map(|(_, i)| i).collect()

        .collect();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    out
}

    pub fn insert(&self, id: u64, vector: Vec<f32>) {

fn build_ivf(store: &VectorStore) -> IvfIndex {
    let n = store.len();
    let nc = N_CLUSTERS.min(n);
    let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
    eprintln!("[IVF] {nc} clusters, {n} vecs");

    let step = n / nc;
    let mut centroids: Vec<f32> = (0..nc)
        .flat_map(|i| store.data[i * step * 128..(i * step + 1) * 128].iter().copied())
        .collect();

    let mut asgn = vec![0u32; n];

    for iter in 0..KMEANS_ITERS {
        let sp = store.data.as_ptr() as usize;
        let cp = centroids.as_ptr() as usize;

        let new_asgn: Vec<u32> = (0..n).into_par_iter().map(|i| {
            let v = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts((sp as *const f32).add(i*128), 128) };

            for c in 0..nc {
                let cen = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts((cp as *const f32).add(c*128), 128) };
                let d = l2_distance_f32(v, cen);
                if d < bd { bd = d; bc = c as u32; }
            }
            bc
        }).collect();

        let chg = asgn.iter().zip(&new_asgn).filter(|(a,b)| a!=b).count();
        asgn = new_asgn;

        let mut sums = vec![0f32; nc * 128];
        let mut cnts = vec![0u32; nc];
        for i in 0..n {
            let c = asgn[i] as usize;
            cnts[c] += 1;
            let v = &store.data[i*128..(i+1)*128];
            let s = &mut sums[c*128..(c+1)*128];
            for j in 0..128 { s[j] += v[j]; }
        }
        for c in 0..nc {
            let cnt = cnts[c].max(1) as f32;
            let cen = &mut centroids[c*128..(c+1)*128];
            let s = &sums[c*128..(c+1)*128];
            for j in 0..128 { cen[j] = s[j] / cnt; }
        }
        eprintln!("[IVF] iter {}/{}: {} chg ({:.2}s)", iter+1, KMEANS_ITERS, chg, t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
        if chg == 0 { break; }
    }

    let mut lists: Vec<Vec<u32>> = (0..nc).map(|_| Vec::new()).collect();
    for (i, &c) in asgn.iter().enumerate() { lists[c as usize].push(i as u32); }

    eprintln!("[IVF] built in {:.2}s, avg list {}", t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), n/nc);
    IvfIndex { centroids, lists, n: nc }
}

fn nearest_n(ivf: &IvfIndex, q: &[f32], k: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k+1);
    for i in 0..ivf.n {
        let c = &ivf.centroids[i*128..(i+1)*128];
        let d = l2_distance_f32(q, c);
        let e = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: i as u64 };
        if heap.len() < k { heap.push(e); }
        else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 { heap.pop(); heap.push(e); }
    }
    let mut v: Vec<_> = heap.into_iter().map(|e|(e.dist.0,e.id as usize)).collect();
    v.sort_unstable_by(|a,b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    v.into_iter().map(|(_,i)| i).collect()
}

fn search_ivf(store: &VectorStore, ivf: &IvfIndex, q: &[f32], k: usize) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    let probes = nearest_n(ivf, q, N_PROBES);
    let mut cands: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    for &cid in &probes { cands.extend_from_slice(&ivf.lists[cid]); }
    let n = cands.len();
    let k = k.min(n);
    if k == 0 { return Vec::new(); }

    let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k+1);
    for &idx in &cands {
        let idx = idx as usize;
        let v = &store.data[idx*128..(idx+1)*128];
        let d = l2_distance_f32(q, v);
        let e = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: store.ids[idx] };
        if heap.len() < k { heap.push(e); }
        else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 { heap.pop(); heap.push(e); }
    }

    let mut out: Vec<SearchResult> = heap.into_iter()
        .map(|e| SearchResult { id: e.id, distance: e.dist.0 as f64 }).collect();
    out.sort_by(|a,b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));
    out
}

fn search_brute(store: &VectorStore, q: &[f32], k: usize) -> Vec<SearchResult> {
    let n = store.len();
    let k = k.min(n);
    if k == 0 { return Vec::new(); }

        }

pub fn l2_distance(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f64 {

/// Squared L2 distance as f32 (inner use).

pub fn l2_distance_f32(a: &[f32], b: &[f32]) -> f32 {
    // Always use scalar — the compiler will auto-vectorize with target-cpu=native
    let mut s = 0.0f32;
    // Manual unroll for 128 dims

        let d1 = a[i+1] - b[i+1];
        let d2 = a[i+2] - b[i+2];
        let d3 = a[i+3] - b[i+3];
        let d4 = a[i+4] - b[i+4];
        let d5 = a[i+5] - b[i+5];
        let d6 = a[i+6] - b[i+6];
        let d7 = a[i+7] - b[i+7];
        s += d0*d0 + d1*d1 + d2*d2 + d3*d3 + d4*d4 + d5*d5 + d6*d6 + d7*d7;
        i += 8;
    }
    while i < n {
        let d = a[i] - b[i];
        s += d * d;
        i += 1;
    }
    s
}

            if start >= end { return Vec::new(); }

            let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
            for i in start..end {
                let v = &data[i * 128..(i + 1) * 128];
                let d = l2_distance_f32(vector, v);
                let e = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id: ids[i] };
                if heap.len() < k {
                    heap.push(e);
                } else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 {
                    heap.pop();
                    heap.push(e);
                }
            }
            heap.into_iter().map(|e| (e.dist.0, e.id)).collect()
        }).collect();

        let mut heap: BinaryHeap<HeapEntry> = BinaryHeap::with_capacity(k + 1);
        for chunk in results {
            for (d, id) in chunk {
                let e = HeapEntry { dist: OrdF32(d), id };
                if heap.len() < k { heap.push(e); }
                else if d < heap.peek().unwrap().dist.0 { heap.pop(); heap.push(e); }
            }
        }

        let mut out: Vec<SearchResult> = heap.into_iter()
            .map(|e| SearchResult { id: e.id, distance: e.dist.0 as f64 }).collect();
        out.sort_by(|a, b| a.distance.partial_cmp(&b.distance).unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal));

}
